derivative.selection_strategy: all source record identities, source best, first/last; longest-gap rank fill

metadata.record_semantics: at least the best mean through the entire batch minus 1e-14
metadata.simultaneous_labels: shuffled within each batch per replicate; record flags remain attached

protocol.purpose: Frozen no-H8 SRC and requested KL variant, independent of historical candidate outcomes

screen_all.preservation: All record/new-best identities, first/last arms, and complete five-arm burst batches; increase actual K above target when mandatory records require it. Compress distinct source batches to distinct physical times.
screen_all.record_dependent_noise: Recompute flags after selecting whole batches. Keep record identities and record any changed noise classes in derivative metadata.
screen_all.selection: Frozen means and birth schedules only; deterministic longest-gap rank fill; no outcomes used.
